description: This PHP class defines the TerminationReasonModel, which serves as a data model for termination reasons within the OrangeHRM system. It implements normalization and serialization behavior, wrapping the TerminationReason entity and providing mechanisms to filter and attribute names for API responses.

classes.name: TerminationReasonModel
classes.description: A model class for representing termination reasons, implementing normalization for API outputs, utilizing traits for common serialization behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a TerminationReason entity, setting filters and attribute mappings.
